traditions.VUL: Et transívi ad portam fontis , et ad aquædúctum regis ,
traditions.KJV: Then I went on to the gate of the fountain , and to the king ’s pool :

14.english_reference: but [ there was ] no place for the beast

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵין מָק֥וֹם לַ בְּהֵמָ֖ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἦν τόπος τῷ κτήνει
traditions.VUL: et non erat locus iuménto ,
traditions.KJV: but [ there was ] no place for the beast [ that was ]

14.english_reference: [ that was ] under me to pass

traditions.WLC: לַ עֲבֹ֥ר תַּחְתָּֽ י
traditions.LXX: παρελθεῖν ὑποκάτω μου .
traditions.VUL: cui sedébam , ut transíret .
traditions.KJV: under me to pass .

15.english_reference: Then went I up in the night by the brook

traditions.WLC: וָ אֱהִ֨י עֹלֶ֤ה בַ נַּ֨חַל֙ לַ֔יְלָה
traditions.VUL: Et ascéndi per torréntem nocte ,
traditions.KJV: Then went I up in the night by the brook ,

traditions.WLC: וָ אֱהִ֥י שֹׂבֵ֖ר בַּ חוֹמָ֑ה
traditions.VUL: et considerábam murum ,
traditions.KJV: and viewed the wall ,

15.english_reference: and turned back , and entered by the gate of the valley

traditions.WLC: וָ אָשׁ֗וּב וָ אָב֛וֹא בְּ שַׁ֥עַר הַ גַּ֖יְא
traditions.VUL: et revérsus veni ad portam vallis ,
traditions.KJV: and turned back , and entered by the gate of the valley ,

traditions.WLC: וָ אָשֽׁוּב
traditions.VUL: et rédii .
traditions.KJV: and [ so ] returned .

16.english_reference: And the rulers knew not whither I went ,

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ סְּגָנִ֗ים לֹ֤א יָדְעוּ֙ אָ֣נָה הָלַ֔כְתִּי
traditions.VUL: Magistrátus autem nesciébant quo abiíssem ,
traditions.KJV: And the rulers knew not whither I went ,

traditions.WLC: וּ מָ֖ה אֲנִ֣י עֹשֶׂ֑ה
traditions.VUL: aut quid ego fácerem :
traditions.KJV: or what I did ;

16.english_reference: neither had I as yet told [ it ] to the Jews ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לַ יְּהוּדִ֨ים
traditions.VUL: sed et Iudǽis ,
traditions.KJV: neither had I as yet told [ it ] to the Jews ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לַ כֹּהֲנִ֜ים
traditions.VUL: et sacerdótibus ,
traditions.KJV: nor to the priests ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לַ חֹרִ֣ים
traditions.VUL: et optimátibus ,
traditions.KJV: nor to the nobles ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לַ סְּגָנִ֗ים
traditions.VUL: et magistrátibus ,
traditions.KJV: nor to the rulers ,

16.english_reference: nor to the rest that did the work .

traditions.WLC: וּ לְ יֶ֨תֶר֙ עֹשֵׂ֣ה הַ מְּלָאכָ֔ה עַד כֵּ֖ן לֹ֥א הִגַּֽדְתִּי
traditions.VUL: et réliquis qui faciébant opus , usque ad id loci nihil indicáveram .
traditions.KJV: nor to the rest that did the work .

17.english_reference: Then said I unto them , Ye see the distress that we [ are ] in

traditions.WLC: וָ אוֹמַ֣ר אֲלֵ הֶ֗ם אַתֶּ֤ם רֹאִים֙ הָ רָעָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲנַ֣חְנוּ בָ֔ הּ
traditions.VUL: Et dixi eis : Vos nostis afflictiónem in qua sumus :
traditions.KJV: Then said I unto them , Ye see the distress that we [ are ] in ,

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֤ר יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ חֲרֵבָ֔ה
traditions.VUL: quia Ierúsalem desérta est ,
traditions.KJV: how Jerusalem [ lieth ] waste ,

17.english_reference: and the gates thereof are burned with fire

traditions.WLC: וּ שְׁעָרֶ֖י הָ נִצְּת֣וּ בָ אֵ֑שׁ
traditions.VUL: et portæ eius consúmptæ sunt igni :
traditions.KJV: and the gates thereof are burned with fire :

17.english_reference: come , and let us build up the wall of Jerusalem , that we be no more a reproach

traditions.WLC: לְכ֗וּ וְ נִבְנֶה֙ אֶת חוֹמַ֣ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְ לֹא נִהְיֶ֥ה ע֖וֹד חֶרְפָּֽה
traditions.VUL: veníte , et ædificémus muros Ierúsalem , et non simus ultra oppróbrium .
traditions.KJV: come , and let us build up the wall of Jerusalem , that we be no more a reproach .

18.english_reference: Then I told them of the hand of my God which was good upon me ; as also the king ’s words that he had spoken unto me

traditions.WLC: וָ אַגִּ֨יד לָ הֶ֜ם אֶת יַ֣ד אֱלֹהַ֗ י אֲשֶׁר הִיא֙ טוֹבָ֣ה עָלַ֔ י וְ אַף דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָֽמַר לִ֑ י
traditions.VUL: Et indicávi eis manum Dei mei , quod esset bona mecum , et verba regis , quæ locútus esset mihi ,
traditions.KJV: Then I told them of the hand of my God which was good upon me ; as also the king ’s words that he had spoken unto me .

18.english_reference: And they said , Let us rise up and build

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ נָק֣וּם וּ בָנִ֔ינוּ
traditions.VUL: et aio : Surgámus , et ædificémus .
traditions.KJV: And they said , Let us rise up and build .

18.english_reference: So they strengthened their hands for [ this ] good [ work ]

traditions.WLC: וַ יְחַזְּק֥וּ יְדֵי הֶ֖ם לַ טּוֹבָֽה
traditions.VUL: Et confortátæ sunt manus eórum in bono .
traditions.KJV: So they strengthened their hands for [ this ] good [ work ] .

19.english_reference: But when Sanballat the Horonite , and Tobiah the servant , the Ammonite , and Geshem the Arabian , heard [ it ]

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁמַע֩ סַנְבַלַּ֨ט הַ חֹרֹנִ֜י וְ טֹבִיָּ֣ה הָ עֶ֣בֶד הָֽ עַמּוֹנִ֗י וְ גֶ֨שֶׁם֙ הָֽ עַרְבִ֔י
traditions.VUL: Audiérunt autem Sanabállat Horonítes , et Tobías servus Ammanítes , et Gosem Arabs ,
traditions.KJV: But when Sanballat the Horonite , and Tobiah the servant , the Ammonite , and Geshem the Arabian , heard [ it ] ,

19.english_reference: they laughed us to scorn , and despised us

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּלְעִ֣גוּ לָ֔ נוּ וַ יִּבְז֖וּ עָלֵ֑י נוּ
traditions.VUL: et subsannavérunt nos , et despexérunt ,
traditions.KJV: they laughed us to scorn , and despised us ,

19.english_reference: and said , What [ is ] this thing that ye do ? will ye rebel against the king ?

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּאמְר֗וּ מָֽה הַ דָּבָ֤ר הַ זֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתֶּ֣ם עֹשִׂ֔ים הַ עַ֥ל הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ אַתֶּ֥ם מֹרְדִֽים
traditions.VUL: dixerúntque : Quæ est hæc res , quam fácitis ? numquid contra regem vos rebellátis ?
traditions.KJV: and said , What [ is ] this thing that ye do ? will ye rebel against the king ?

20.english_reference: Then answered I them , and said unto them

traditions.WLC: וָ אָשִׁ֨יב אוֹתָ֜ ם דָּבָ֗ר וָ אוֹמַ֤ר לָ הֶם֙
traditions.VUL: Et réddidi eis sermónem , dixíque ad eos :
traditions.KJV: Then answered I them , and said unto them ,

20.english_reference: The God of heaven , he will prosper us ; therefore we his servants will arise and build

traditions.WLC: אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַ שָּׁמַ֔יִם ה֚וּא יַצְלִ֣יחַֽ לָ֔ נוּ וַ אֲנַ֥חְנוּ עֲבָדָ֖י ו נָק֣וּם וּ בָנִ֑ינוּ
traditions.VUL: Deus cæli ipse nos iuvat , et nos servi eius sumus : surgámus et ædificémus :
traditions.KJV: The God of heaven , he will prosper us ; therefore we his servants will arise and build :

20.english_reference: but ye have no portion , nor right , nor memorial , in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וְ לָ כֶ֗ם אֵֽין חֵ֧לֶק וּ צְדָקָ֛ה וְ זִכָּר֖וֹן בִּ ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
traditions.VUL: vobis autem non est pars , et iustítia , et memória in Ierúsalem .
traditions.KJV: but ye have no portion , nor right , nor memorial , in Jerusalem .
